assertion.statement: The metric lbipam_ips_available_total has been renamed to lbipam_ips_available.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: Metric names have no matching subject family for a rename; the rename is stated but cannot be expressed with replacedBy in the same family.; applicability: Whether dashboards or alerts query the old metric name is not visible in configuration or stated in the evidence.; consequence: Evidence states only the rename, not what happens to consumers of the old metric name.
